description: This file defines the `GatewayWebsocketSessionClosedException` class, a specific exception used within the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate that a websocket session has been closed due to a change in the authorization context. It includes metadata, builder patterns, and methods for constructing instances from messages or JSON objects.

classes.name: GatewayWebsocketSessionClosedException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception indicating that the websocket session was closed due to a change in authorization context. It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements GatewayException. It provides static methods for creating instances from messages or JSON, and contains an inner builder class for constructing instances.
